title: First Longest String in an Array

tests.title: Works with the example
tests.fail_how: Recorre una vez guardando el mejor visto hasta el momento.
tests.fail_how_en: Walk once keeping the best seen so far.

tests.title: On a tie returns the first one
tests.fail_why: En un empate devolviste el último (usaste >= en lugar de >).
tests.fail_how: Actualiza solo con ESTRICTAMENTE mayor: if (arr[i].length() > best.length()). Con >= el último empatado gana.
tests.fail_why_en: On a tie you returned the last one (you used >= instead of >).
tests.fail_how_en: Update only on STRICTLY greater: if (arr[i].length() > best.length()). With >= the last tied element wins.

tests.title: Handles null, empty and single-element arrays
tests.fail_why: Falla con null, vacío o con cadenas vacías.
tests.fail_how: Primera línea: if (arr == null || arr.length == 0) return "".
tests.fail_why_en: Fails with null, empty, or empty strings.
tests.fail_how_en: First line: if (arr == null || arr.length == 0) return "".

tests.title: Does not modify the input array
tests.fail_why: Ordenaste o modificaste el arreglo recibido (efecto secundario).
tests.fail_how: Si ordenaste con Arrays.sort, cambiaste los datos del llamador. Recorrer una vez es más simple, O(n) y sin efectos secundarios.
tests.fail_why_en: You sorted or modified the received array (side effect).
tests.fail_how_en: If you used Arrays.sort you changed the caller's data. A single pass is simpler, O(n) and has no side effects.

tests.title: O(n): works with 1,000,000 elements
tests.fail_why: Tu solución no es lineal (ordenar es O(n log n); comparar todos contra todos es O(n²)).
tests.fail_how: Un solo recorrido, O(n) tiempo y O(1) espacio.
tests.fail_why_en: Your solution is not linear (sorting is O(n log n); comparing all against all is O(n²)).
tests.fail_how_en: A single pass, O(n) time and O(1) space.

author: Javier Morales Barrera (@jaydelmoral), with Claude (Anthropic)
